## Specification

### Component: Password strength

A live 4-segment meter and a requirement checklist placed under a password input. A pure `scorePassword`
helper (no DOM) does the scoring so forms can reuse it.

#### Anatomy
```
<div class="ui-password-strength" id data-level="empty|weak|fair|good|strong" data-score="0–4">
  <div class="ui-password-strength-header">
    <div class="ui-password-strength-meter" role="meter" aria-label="Password strength"
         aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="4" aria-valuenow aria-valuetext="Good">
      <span class="ui-password-strength-segment" [data-filled] style="--ui-i: n"></span> × 4
    </div>
    <span class="ui-password-strength-label" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">Good</span>
  </div>
  <ul class="ui-password-strength-checklist" aria-label="Password requirements">
    <li class="ui-password-strength-requirement" data-id [data-met]>
      <span class="ui-password-strength-mark" aria-hidden="true"><svg check 10px, stroke 3/></span>
      <span class="ui-password-strength-sr">Met: | Not met: </span>
      <span class="ui-password-strength-text">At least 8 characters</span>
    </li>
  </ul>
</div>
```

#### Props
- `value` (string, required); `requirements` (`{ id, label, test(password) }[]`, default 8+ characters,
  upper and lower case, a number, a symbol); `labels` (`{ weak, fair, good, strong }`, default
  Weak / Fair / Good / Strong); `showChecklist` (default true); `showLabel` (default true);
  `meterLabel` (default "Password strength"). Native div props forwarded (`id`, `ref`, `className`).
- Exports: `PasswordStrength`, `scorePassword`, `defaultPasswordRequirements`, `passwordStrengthLevels`,
  `passwordHasSequence`, `isCommonPassword` and their types.

#### Scoring (`scorePassword`)
- Empty → score 0, level `empty`, nothing met. Requirements are never met by an empty password.
- Points: length (in code points) 8–11 → 1, 12–15 → 2, 16+ → 3; plus character classes − 1 (lower, upper,
  number, symbol = anything not a letter or number); minus 1 for a straight run of 4 (`abcd`, `4321`).
- Map: 0–1 → 1 weak, 2–3 → 2 fair, 4 → 3 good, 5+ → 4 strong.
- A common password (contains `password`, `qwerty`, `123456`…) or one repeated character → 1.
- Strong (4) only when every requirement is met; otherwise capped at 3.

#### Visual rules
- Root: grid, 10px gap, 13px text. Tone by level: weak `--ui-destructive` / `--ui-destructive-text`, fair
  `--ui-warning` / `--ui-warning-text`, good and strong `--ui-success` / `--ui-success-text`.
- Header: flex, 12px gap. Meter: 4 equal columns, 4px gap; segment 4px tall, pill radius, track
  `color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 10%, transparent)`; fill is an `::after` in the tone colour.
- Label: 12px/500, min-width 52px, end-aligned, in the tone's text colour.
- Checklist: no bullets, 6px row gap; row is flex, 8px gap, `--ui-muted-foreground`, met → `--ui-foreground`.
- Mark: 16px circle, inset 1.5px `--ui-border-strong` ring; met → `--ui-success` fill and ring, check in
  `--ui-success-foreground`.

#### Motion
- Segment fill: `transform: scaleX(0 → 1)` from the start edge (right in RTL) on `--ui-spring-smooth`
  (540ms), `transition-delay: calc(var(--ui-i) * var(--ui-stagger))` where `--ui-i` counts from the previous
  score (rising: i − previous − 1; falling: previous − i), so only changing segments are staggered.
- Background colour changes over `--ui-duration` (220ms) with no delay.
- Met mark: `ui-password-strength-tick` (scale .7 → 1) on `--ui-spring-snappy`; check scales .4 → 1 and
  fades in.
- Reduced motion: no stagger, no tick animation; the global rule makes transitions instant.

#### Accessibility
- The input's `aria-describedby` points at the root `id`, so the field reads the strength and checklist.
- `role="meter"` with value 0–4 and the level word as value text.
- The level word is the only live region (polite, atomic), so it speaks when the level changes, not per key.
- Requirement state is in hidden text ("Met:" / "Not met:"); marks are decorative.

#### Acceptance checks
- Typing `Tr0ub4dor&3` gives 3 filled segments, level `good`, all 4 requirements met.
- Typing `password` gives level `weak` and 1 filled segment.
- Clearing the field resets to `data-level="empty"` with no filled segments and an empty label.
- Each met row has `data-met` and its hidden text says "Met:".
- Works in light and dark; axe finds no serious violations.

### `ui/components/password-strength/password-score.ts`

```ts
/* Pure scoring behind PasswordStrength. No DOM, no React: safe on the server and in tests.
   It is a guide for the user while typing, not a security check — validate on the server too. */

export interface PasswordRequirement {
  /** Stable key (React key and data attribute). */
  id: string;
  /** Shown in the checklist, e.g. "At least 8 characters". */
  label: string;
  /** True when the password meets it. */
  test: (password: string) => boolean;
}

export interface PasswordRequirementResult {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  met: boolean;
}

/** 0 empty · 1 weak · 2 fair · 3 good · 4 strong. */
export type PasswordScore = 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;
export type PasswordStrengthLevel = 'empty' | 'weak' | 'fair' | 'good' | 'strong';

export interface PasswordStrengthResult {
  score: PasswordScore;
  level: PasswordStrengthLevel;
  requirements: PasswordRequirementResult[];
  /** How many requirements are met. */
  metCount: number;
}

export const passwordStrengthLevels: readonly PasswordStrengthLevel[] = ['empty', 'weak', 'fair', 'good', 'strong'];

/** The default checklist: length, mixed case, a number, a symbol. */
export const defaultPasswordRequirements: readonly PasswordRequirement[] = [
  { id: 'length', label: 'At least 8 characters', test: (p) => Array.from(p).length >= 8 },
  { id: 'case', label: 'Upper and lower case letters', test: (p) => /\p{Ll}/u.test(p) && /\p{Lu}/u.test(p) },
  { id: 'number', label: 'A number', test: (p) => /\p{N}/u.test(p) },
  { id: 'symbol', label: 'A symbol', test: (p) => /[^\p{L}\p{N}]/u.test(p) },
];

/** Passwords (and their obvious stems) that are always weak, whatever else they contain. */
const COMMON = [
  'password', 'passw0rd', 'qwerty', 'letmein', 'welcome', 'admin', 'iloveyou', 'monkey', 'dragon',
  'football', 'baseball', 'sunshine', 'princess', 'abc123', '123456', '111111', '000000',
];

function characterClasses(password: string): number {
  return [/\p{Ll}/u, /\p{Lu}/u, /\p{N}/u, /[^\p{L}\p{N}]/u].filter((re) => re.test(password)).length;
}

/** True when the password has 4+ characters in a straight run: "abcd", "4321", "wxyz". */
export function passwordHasSequence(password: string, run = 4): boolean {
  const codes = Array.from(password.toLowerCase(), (c) => c.codePointAt(0)!);
  let up = 1;
  let down = 1;
  for (let i = 1; i < codes.length; i++) {
    up = codes[i] === codes[i - 1]! + 1 ? up + 1 : 1;
    down = codes[i] === codes[i - 1]! - 1 ? down + 1 : 1;
    if (up >= run || down >= run) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** True when the password is mostly one repeated character or contains a common password. */
export function isCommonPassword(password: string): boolean {
  const lower = password.toLowerCase();
  if (/^(.)\1*$/u.test(lower)) return true;
  return COMMON.some((word) => lower.includes(word));
}

/**
 * Score a password from 0 to 4.
 *
 * Points: length (8–11 → 1, 12–15 → 2, 16+ → 3) plus variety (character classes − 1, up to 3),
 * minus 1 for a straight run like "1234". Points map to 1 weak (0–1) · 2 fair (2–3) · 3 good (4) ·
 * 4 strong (5+). A common password or a single repeated character is always weak, and "strong"
 * needs every requirement met. Any non-empty password scores at least 1.
 */
export function scorePassword(
  password: string,
  requirements: readonly PasswordRequirement[] = defaultPasswordRequirements,
): PasswordStrengthResult {
  const results = requirements.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, label: r.label, met: password.length > 0 && r.test(password) }));
  const metCount = results.filter((r) => r.met).length;
  if (!password) return { score: 0, level: 'empty', requirements: results, metCount };

  const length = Array.from(password).length;
  let points = length >= 16 ? 3 : length >= 12 ? 2 : length >= 8 ? 1 : 0;
  points += Math.max(0, characterClasses(password) - 1);
  if (passwordHasSequence(password)) points -= 1;

  let score: PasswordScore = points >= 5 ? 4 : points >= 4 ? 3 : points >= 2 ? 2 : 1;
  if (isCommonPassword(password)) score = 1;
  if (score === 4 && metCount < results.length) score = 3;

  return { score, level: passwordStrengthLevels[score]!, requirements: results, metCount };
}
```

### `ui/components/password-strength/password-strength.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, type CSSProperties, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import {
  defaultPasswordRequirements,
  scorePassword,
  type PasswordRequirement,
  type PasswordStrengthLevel,
} from './password-score';

export type PasswordStrengthLabels = Partial<Record<Exclude<PasswordStrengthLevel, 'empty'>, string>>;

const DEFAULT_LABELS: Required<PasswordStrengthLabels> = { weak: 'Weak', fair: 'Fair', good: 'Good', strong: 'Strong' };
const SEGMENTS = [1, 2, 3, 4] as const;

export interface PasswordStrengthProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children'> {
  /** The password being typed. Scored on every render with `scorePassword`. */
  value: string;
  /** The checklist. Default: 8+ characters, upper and lower case, a number, a symbol. */
  requirements?: readonly PasswordRequirement[];
  /** Words for each level. Default Weak / Fair / Good / Strong. */
  labels?: PasswordStrengthLabels;
  /** Show the requirement checklist. Default `true`. */
  showChecklist?: boolean;
  /** Show the level word beside the meter (also the polite live region). Default `true`. */
  showLabel?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the meter. Default "Password strength". */
  meterLabel?: string;
}

/**
 * PasswordStrength — a 4-segment meter and a requirement checklist that follow a password as it is
 * typed. Place it under the input and point the input's `aria-describedby` at this element's `id`.
 * Segments fill in order on the smooth spring (staggered from the last score); met requirements tick
 * with a snappy pop. The level word is announced politely only when it changes.
 */
export const PasswordStrength = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, PasswordStrengthProps>(function PasswordStrength(
  {
    value,
    requirements = defaultPasswordRequirements,
    labels,
    showChecklist = true,
    showLabel = true,
    meterLabel = 'Password strength',
    className,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const result = useMemo(() => scorePassword(value, requirements), [value, requirements]);
  const { score, level } = result;
  const words = { ...DEFAULT_LABELS, ...labels };
  const word = level === 'empty' ? '' : words[level];

  // Stagger relative to the previous score, so only the segments that change wait their turn
  const previous = useRef(score);
  const from = previous.current;
  useEffect(() => {
    previous.current = score;
  });
  const order = (i: number) => {
    if (score > from && i > from && i <= score) return i - from - 1;
    if (score < from && i > score && i <= from) return from - i;
    return 0;
  };

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-password-strength', className)} data-level={level} data-score={score} {...props}>
      <div className="ui-password-strength-header">
        <div
          className="ui-password-strength-meter"
          role="meter"
          aria-label={meterLabel}
          aria-valuemin={0}
          aria-valuemax={4}
          aria-valuenow={score}
          aria-valuetext={word || 'Empty'}
        >
          {SEGMENTS.map((i) => (
            <span
              key={i}
              className="ui-password-strength-segment"
              data-filled={i <= score ? '' : undefined}
              style={{ '--ui-i': order(i) } as CSSProperties}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
        {showLabel && (
          <span className="ui-password-strength-label" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
            {word}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      {showChecklist && result.requirements.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="ui-password-strength-checklist" aria-label="Password requirements">
          {result.requirements.map((r) => (
            <li key={r.id} className="ui-password-strength-requirement" data-id={r.id} data-met={r.met ? '' : undefined}>
              <span className="ui-password-strength-mark" aria-hidden="true">
                <Icon name="check" size={10} strokeWidth={3} />
              </span>
              <span className="ui-password-strength-sr">{r.met ? 'Met: ' : 'Not met: '}</span>
              <span className="ui-password-strength-text">{r.label}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/password-strength.css`

```css
/* Password strength -------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-password-strength" data-level="empty|weak|fair|good|strong" data-score="0–4">
     .ui-password-strength-header
       .ui-password-strength-meter (role="meter")
         .ui-password-strength-segment × 4  [data-filled]  style="--ui-i: <stagger order>"
       .ui-password-strength-label (aria-live="polite")   Weak / Fair / Good / Strong
     ul.ui-password-strength-checklist
       li.ui-password-strength-requirement [data-met]
         .ui-password-strength-mark > svg (check)  + .ui-password-strength-sr + .ui-password-strength-text
   Tone: weak → destructive, fair → warning, good/strong → success (fills for bars and marks,
   -text roles for words on the surface).
   Segments fill left to right on the smooth spring, staggered from the previous score;
   met marks pop on the snappy spring. Reduced motion: states change, nothing moves.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-password-strength {
    --ui-password-strength-tone: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    --ui-password-strength-text: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.625rem;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    line-height: var(--text-sm--line-height);
  }
  .ui-password-strength[data-level="weak"] {
    --ui-password-strength-tone: var(--ui-destructive);
    --ui-password-strength-text: var(--ui-destructive-text);
  }
  .ui-password-strength[data-level="fair"] {
    --ui-password-strength-tone: var(--ui-warning);
    --ui-password-strength-text: var(--ui-warning-text);
  }
  .ui-password-strength:is([data-level="good"], [data-level="strong"]) {
    --ui-password-strength-tone: var(--ui-success);
    --ui-password-strength-text: var(--ui-success-text);
  }

  .ui-password-strength-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }

  /* Meter */
  .ui-password-strength-meter {
    display: grid;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }
  .ui-password-strength-segment {
    position: relative;
    height: 0.25rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 10%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-password-strength-segment::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background-color: var(--ui-password-strength-tone);
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: left center;
    transition:
      transform var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth),
      background-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard);
    transition-delay: calc(var(--ui-i, 0) * var(--ui-stagger)), 0ms;
  }
  [dir="rtl"] .ui-password-strength-segment::after { transform-origin: right center; }
  .ui-password-strength-segment[data-filled]::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

  .ui-password-strength-label {
    min-width: 3.25rem;
    color: var(--ui-password-strength-text);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-align: end;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition: color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }

  /* Checklist */
  .ui-password-strength-checklist {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  .ui-password-strength-requirement {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    transition: color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-password-strength-requirement[data-met] { color: var(--ui-foreground); }

  .ui-password-strength-mark {
    display: inline-grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: transparent;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ui-border-strong);
    color: var(--ui-success-foreground);
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-password-strength-mark > svg {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.4);
    transition:
      opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-password-strength-requirement[data-met] .ui-password-strength-mark {
    background-color: var(--ui-success);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ui-success);
    animation: ui-password-strength-tick var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-password-strength-requirement[data-met] .ui-password-strength-mark > svg {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }

  .ui-password-strength-sr {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .ui-password-strength-segment::after { transition-delay: 0ms; }
    .ui-password-strength-requirement[data-met] .ui-password-strength-mark { animation: none; }
  }
}

@keyframes ui-password-strength-tick {
  from { transform: scale(0.7); }
  to { transform: none; }
}
```

## Usage

**Sign-up password** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/password-strength/sign-up.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import { Field, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { PasswordInput } from '@/ui/components/input';
import { PasswordStrength } from '@/ui/components/password-strength';

export default function PasswordStrengthSignUp() {
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const strengthId = useId();

  return (
    <form className="w-full max-w-sm" onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
      <Field>
        <Label>Create a password</Label>
        <PasswordInput
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          autoComplete="new-password"
          aria-describedby={strengthId}
        />
        <PasswordStrength id={strengthId} value={password} className="mt-1.5" />
      </Field>
    </form>
  );
}
```
